context: Asuka prepares a public lecture series with Ren.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: academic planning; vocabulary (講演/講座/講師/定義/事例) in natural home.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 来月、市民向けの講演を行います。
lines.en: Next month I'll give a public lecture.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 連続の講座に、なるんですか?
lines.en: Will it become a lecture series?
lines.style: curious young student voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ、五回の講座を予定しています。
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 他の講師も、呼ぶんですか?
lines.en: Will you invite other lecturers too?
lines.style: engaged young student voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 優れた講師を、数名お招きします。
lines.en: I'll invite a few excellent lecturers.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 難しい言葉の定義も、説明しますか?
lines.en: Will you explain definitions of hard terms?
lines.style: thoughtful young student voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 定義は、具体的な事例で示します。
lines.en: I'll illustrate definitions with concrete cases.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 事例があると、講演が分かりやすいですね。
lines.en: With cases, the lecture is easy to follow.
lines.style: understanding young student voice, soft warm realization throughout
